corrections.what: Drew all 30 seats as filled true circles: 22 black (11 in each side cluster) and 8 red in the central upper cluster, counted from the black sheet
corrections.why: The catalogue asks for filled seat dots counted from the enlarged crop; connected-component counts on the black sheet give 30 separate dots. Filled dots take no stroke, so W does not apply (sheet stroke measure 9.4 px is the dots' width).

corrections.what: Made the chamber mirror-symmetric about x 89.57: each left dot and its right partner share one height and one radius (pair averages)
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The 15 pairs centre between x 89.24 and 89.84; no dot moves more than 0.4 px. Radii still vary across the chamber as drawn, from 5.75 px (inner middle row) to 6.75 px (central cluster).

corrections.what: Left out the hairline bridges that join the central dots on the sheets (x 80.6 on the black sheet; x 80.6 and 98.6 on the red sheet)
corrections.why: DR-03 raster accidents. The bridges are under 2 px wide, differ between the two sheets and join seats the catalogue describes as separate dots.

corrections.what: Left out a small extra red blob at about (70, 28) that appears on the red sheet only
corrections.why: Black and red sheets disagree here. The black sheet has clear ground at this point, the blob is half a seat's size and fused to its neighbour, and the catalogue's central cluster is a set of whole seats, so the black sheet's count is the intended shape.

notes: Kept as drawn: no chamber bands, only dots; the staggered rows and uneven spacing of each side cluster; the central cluster's two columns of three (x 80.6 and 98.6, rows y 14.45, 31.38, 49.71) with one more dot either side at y 18.96 (x 62.4 and 116.8), all red. Red IoU (0.87) is held down by the red sheet's bridges and extra blob, which the trace omits on purpose.
